## Annotation

The page says a new barrier-free entrance was unveiled in 2013 and “named the Mowat Entrance after Doug Mowat, the first MLA to use a wheelchair while in office.” It adds that Mowat “was a tireless advocate for those suffering from spinal cord injuries and physical impairments, spending years working with the B.C. Paraplegic Foundation and the B.C. Paraplegic Association.”

This supports a documented public role for Doug Mowat as MLA and BCPA/Foundation advocate. It does not mention Creekview, ECPM, or CSIL.
